Alright hear it out. Notre Dame goes 11-1, but with a weak schedule. BYU is unranked in this scenario. Their best win is a 3OT squeaker over #11 Miami, and their loss was a headscratcher 40-10 loss to 3-9 Stanford. Going into CCG week, ESPN is salivating that ND might finish at #13 and miss. USF goes 11-1, but no American team is ranked. They finish in the wrong end of a 3-way tiebreaker. Their Playoff hopes are over since the winner of Tulane-UTSA is ahead of them. Notre Dame agrees to a game against USF in South Bend on Championship weekend, terrified of just missing again. USF sees it as their only shot. The NCAA allows this game because the rules don’t apply to Notre Dame. They beat USF by a lot, and end up with the #3 seed at 12-1, making it all the way to the Final, finishing at 14-2.
